That restaurant yesterday was really good! The owner even served dessert on the house, everyone was delighted. Is anyone going running this afternoon? The forecast says it may cloud over a bit in the evening but shouldn't rain. If someone can bring a camera, that would help since I want to upload photos. Also, please transfer your membership fee this week! Treasurer Ms. Sato says she is tallying it up this time. Thank you!

Everyone, I've put together the list of things for next week's school trip: a water bottle, rain gear, a handkerchief, and a bento, four items. Bus fare has already been collected. If anyone can drive, it would help if you could take one extra child. Please reply in this group this week if possible, so I can plan the seats. Thank you in advance.

I just saw some night photos, and the light handling is really skilful. Does anyone know which lens was used? I'm on a standard lens and something always feels missing. If anyone's free this weekend, shall we shoot along the river with tripods and try slower shutter speeds? Let's also check the tide times in advance so we don't waste a trip.

Notice: we're starting preparations for next month's Bon dance festival. Anyone who can gather in front of the community hall at 10 am this coming Sunday, please join. There will be decoration work and drum practice. Snacks to share would also be appreciated. If you can't attend, just let us know in this group. Thank you.

[Forwarded] Apparently the main entrance will be closed for construction from tomorrow. Cars will need to use the back entrance, so please plan ahead now. (Forwarded from a friend, not yet confirmed.) Pass it on to acquaintances right away. Someone at the management company apparently said it, so check the notice board for details. No need to panic.

[Forwarded] Good morning! I hope today is a good day. When you receive this picture, send it to 10 people. A big present will arrive today! If you don't send it right away you'll lose out, so pass it on to everyone. Wishing everyone health and happiness! I've already sent it to 20 people, but no present has arrived yet.

[Forwarded] There have been reports lately of unknown people calling out at front doors around here. Children and elderly residents should not open doors carelessly at night. (Details are unconfirmed, please don't spread unverified information.) Tell your neighbours too. An acquaintance says they saw two people in black jackets.

Forwarding a health article to everyone: drinking eight glasses of warm water a day supposedly lowers blood pressure and cures insomnia. The title is catchy, but I couldn't find the source, so take it as a reference only. The weekend book club goes ahead as planned on the third floor of the community hall. If you have high blood pressure, don't stop your medicine on your own; talk to your doctor first.

Residents, this Saturday from 9 am we are holding a waste-sorting briefing in the courtyard. Families with children are welcome. Eco bags and prizes will be handed out on the day. Also, from next Wednesday the elevator will be inspected and stopped for about two hours, so please use it at different times. Thank you for your cooperation. Registration closes Friday evening.

gloss_title: School district parents meeting - Teacher Hayashi
gloss_text: Dear parents, next Monday we will hold a parents' meeting at school. It starts at 15:30 in the hall of building 2. We will explain the end-of-term revision schedule and life during the holidays, so please arrive on time if you can. If there is a special circumstance, tell the homeroom teacher in advance. After the meeting we will also explain how to read the report card.

This coming Sunday at 8:30 am we'll meet at the park for river-cleaning volunteer work. It takes about two hours. Please bring your own work gloves and water bottle; rubbish bags will be handed out on the day. If you're joining, reply in the group with Joining. We'll have a simple lunch together afterwards.

[Emergency information] Heavy rain may flood some roads in this area. Avoid low ground and do not drive through water. If you feel in danger, call 119 and wait for rescue on higher ground. Stay away from riverbanks and underground car parks, and watch for the latest official information.

URGENT notice: there has been a gas leak in building 3. The gas company has already been called and is on the way. Every unit must close the gas shut-off valve right away, open windows for ventilation, avoid flames and electrical switches, and gather in the courtyard promptly. Please make sure households with elderly people or children are informed.

URGENT: a fire has broken out on the east side of the apartment complex, and residents are being evacuated. Residents of buildings 1 to 6 must head straight to the north plaza by the evacuation route. Do not use the lift, and do not go back for belongings. Fire crews have arrived; follow the instructions of staff on site. If anyone is trapped, call 119 immediately.

This is a visitor notice. Mr. Yamada has arrived at the front entrance and entry registration is in progress. Registration should finish in about three minutes. The visitor is carrying a paper bag, which the building manager is holding for now. When convenient, confirm in the app whether he may go up to the second floor. If not needed, you can simply decline the registration.

The entrance camera detected a delivery person waiting for the door to open; they say it's a fresh-food delivery. You can check the live feed in the app and choose whether to allow entry. If nothing is done, this notice closes automatically after five minutes and the parcel goes into the designated box at the entrance.

Today's visitor log has been updated. Two visitors entered the building in the afternoon: a moving company staff member and a facilities inspection engineer. Both are registered. You can see the full record on your device screen. If you have questions, contact the management company. It is a routine notice and needs no immediate action.
